_evidence.ref_code:
def add_group(self, key, name, description, permissions, subgroups, default=False, removable=True, changeable=True, toggleable=True, overwrite=False):
    if key in self._groups and not overwrite:
        raise GroupAlreadyExists(key)
    group = Group(key, name, description=description, permissions=self._to_permissions(*permissions), subgroups=self._to_groups(*subgroups), default=default, changeable=changeable, removable=removable, toggleable=toggleable)
    self._groups[key] = group
    self._dirty = True
    self._save()
    self._notify_listeners('added', group)
